VRL Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about offer opening advertisement of the Buyback of 87,50,000 equity shares of face value of Rs.10/- each at price of Rs.320/- per share.
VRL Logistics shares surge 14% to 52-week high as Q2 PAT doubles, up 40% from year-low; check results, buyback details
items.summary: VRL Logistics shares surged 14.3% to a fresh 52-week high of ₹319 after the company reported Q2 FY27 profit more than doubled to ₹103 crore and revenue rose 20.7% to ₹962 crore. The company had also approved a ₹280 crore share buyback last month.
